_meta.rule: The anniversaries are the editorial calendar for a decade (proposal §VIII). Each date is a journal entry, a pin set, an email, a video, and a reason to reprint. The Herald keeps the appointments; the calendar writes the plan.
_meta.fixed_peaks: Every July 4 (the edition) and every August (the classroom) are the two fixed revenue peaks.

dates.name: Constitution Day — soft launch
dates.actions: Store live, digital catalog only. Sixty pins banked, first five videos posted, business mailing to law firms. Journal: constitution-day.

dates.name: First press run
dates.actions: Print the top four sellers from the demand test. Printed catalog mails. Stock ledger opens.

dates.name: Veterans Day
dates.actions: Journal entry, email in letter voice, pin set. Veterans' posts on the business list.

dates.name: Bill of Rights Day
dates.actions: Holiday postcard through the mailhouse, framed editions push, gift messaging. Journal: bill-of-rights-day.

dates.name: THE GATE
dates.actions: 150 orders or $5,000, decided from data/orders/orders.csv, or the press does not run again [D11]. The Chronicler prepares the gate report the week prior; Jacob, Ben, and David decide together.

dates.name: Texas Independence Day
dates.actions: The Texas line and the home market. Austin press coverage attempt.

dates.name: Independence Day
dates.actions: The Declaration edition — the flagship's day [D4]. The year's largest email and mailing.

dates.name: Back to school
dates.actions: Classroom sets, wholesale to co-ops and schools. The August peak.

dates.name: Constitution Day
dates.actions: Anniversary of the store itself. Year-one retrospective in the journal.

dates.name: Saratoga at 250
dates.actions: The battle that brought France into the war. New map candidate — goes through the D3 replacement question or waits for the second sixteen.

dates.name: Valley Forge at 250
dates.actions: Journal and email. Candidate sheet for the second sixteen.

dates.name: Yorktown at 250
dates.actions: Major date. Plan a year ahead.

dates.name: The Constitution at 250
dates.actions: The decade's summit. If the shop keeps its appointments, this is the year it has been building toward.
